Subject: Procurement gap review & AWS co-sell intake — Aurora Medical Systems

Hi Gabe —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Wanted to kick off the intake here so we can make the ACE registration and co-sell path as frictionless as possible. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm procurement contact and preferred PO/contracting workflow (we sometimes need a master services agreement + PO).
- Share current marketplace technical contact for listing artifacts (SaaS listing, AMI details, pricing matrix).
- Tell us about any regulatory or data residency constraints that should be surfaced to AWS for co-sell eligibility.

I attached our co-sell requirements doc (rw_co-sell_requirements_v2.pdf) — it lists the typical gating items AWS wants for ACE registration and the PDM/PSM checklist we use. Can procurement fill the short Excel form and return? (attachment: auroramed_procurement_form.xlsx)

Next steps we propose:
1) Procurement completes the spreadsheet by EOD Tue (4/20).
2) We introduce the AWS PDM/PSM and request ACE enrollment (we can do this once the procurement form + basic marketplace artifacts are present).
3) Schedule a 30-min alignment between Aurora procurement, Redwood sales, and AWS PDM for Wed or Thu.

Marissa, Aditya — please hold a 30-min slot tomorrow for the kickoff and be ready to walk the intake checklist.

Gabe — feel free to reply with the name of the procurement lead and any immediate questions.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference — Marketplace & Co-sell

Thanks Kimberly — and thanks for the clear checklist.

Quick answers:
- Procurement lead: Laura Nguyen (laura.nguyen@auroramed.com). She's CC'd on this reply (procurement@auroramed.com routes to her).
- Procurement workflow: We require a signed EULA + single PO; our legal team will want to review the standard Redwood terms with a 2-3 business day turnaround.
- Regulatory: We host patient-identifiable data for a subset of our customers in the us-east-1 region; we'll need to call that out for any listing that touches PHI and for the PII controls section.

I've attached the initial procurement form filled with what I know. We still need to confirm the pricing matrix and AMI details from engineering.

On the next steps: Wed/Thu both work for us — prefer Thu morning PT. Please include your AWS contact if you have one so we can loop them into the ACE enrollment conversation.

Best,
Gabe Meyer

gmeyer@auroramed.com | +1 617-555-0199

Laura / Gabe — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Laura, welcome — pleasure to e-meet.

Aditya and Marissa from our marketplace team will lead the technical intake and listing artifacts; Aditya will own the pricing/AMI questions, Marissa will coordinate docs for the PDM/PSM review.

Samantha (AWS PDM) — looping you in to request an ACE registration for Aurora Medical Systems. Per AWS guidance, we should submit the registration once the procurement info + marketplace artifacts are in place; can you confirm the fastest path to get co-sell flagged on the registration? We expect Aurora to need co-sell support for a commercial pilot starting early Q3.

Proposed calendar: Thu 2027-04-22 10:00 PT — 30 min alignment (Aurora procurement + Aurora eng + Redwood PSM + AWS PDM). If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

A couple of notes for Aurora procurement:
- We can sign your PO terms where feasible; our legal team will review standard deviations quickly but need the full EULA first.
- For PHI: we'll mark the listing as handling PHI and include our SOC2 + data flow diagram in the PDM packet.

Thanks —
Kim

Hi Kimberly / Laura / team —

Thanks for the intro and clear packet. I reviewed the partial procurement form and the co-sell requirements doc. We're good to proceed with ACE registration, but a couple of gating items to note so the request can be promoted to co-sell: 

1) Marketplace listing artifacts (AMI or SaaS listing details) with a published pricing matrix.
2) SOC2 report or equivalent security attestation (redacted acceptable) for PDM review.
3) Confirmation of the commercial pilot timing (you mentioned early Q3 — please confirm dates).

I've started the registration under REG-987654 and linked the entry to your AWS account; I'll flag it for co-sell once the above items are uploaded to the registration. ETA for flagging after we receive artifacts: 2-3 business days.

Suggested next step: confirm the Thu 4/22 10:00 PT slot for a 30-min sync so we can go over the SOC2 upload and the pricing matrix format. If you want, I'll share a short template that PDMs prefer for the pricing/discount structure.
